mapper.select: SELECT -- [조건 1] 원래 하시던 대로 멤버의 Role과 매핑된 권한이 있는지 카운트 (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM project_members pm JOIN project_member_roles pmr ON pm.project_member_id = pmr.project_member_id JOIN role_permissions rp ON pmr.role_id = rp.role_id JOIN permissions p ON rp.permission_id = p.permission_id WHERE pm.user_id = #{userId} AND pm.project_id = #{projectId} AND p.permission_method = #{method} AND p.permission_url = #{url}) + -- [조건 2] 💡 해당 프로젝트가 전체 공개(P1)이고, 요청이 조회(GET)면 무조건 1을 더해줌 (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM projects WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND is_public = 'P1' AND #{method} = 'GET') FROM DUAL
